checks.name: phase-b-dsp-sources-exist
command: set -euo pipefail; for f in Source/DSP/RandomWalk.h Source/DSP/RandomWalk.cpp Source/DSP/AllpassChain.h Source/DSP/AllpassChain.cpp Source/DSP/TiltFilter.h Source/DSP/TiltFilter.cpp Source/DSP/Voice.h Source/DSP/Voice.cpp tests/TestMain.cpp tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp; do test -f "$f"; done

checks.name: cmake-registers-phase-b-sources
command: set -euo pipefail; for s in RandomWalk.cpp AllpassChain.cpp TiltFilter.cpp Voice.cpp tests/TestMain.cpp tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp; do grep -q "$s" CMakeLists.txt; done

checks.name: rt-safety-grep-primitives
command: set -euo pipefail; ! grep -E 'std::random_device|malloc\(|new |std::mutex|std::lock_guard' Source/DSP/RandomWalk.cpp Source/DSP/AllpassChain.cpp Source/DSP/TiltFilter.cpp Source/DSP/Voice.cpp
